shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
Traveling to new places can be very exciting.
Cooking at home saves money and is healthier.
I often listen to music while I study or work.
Hiking in the mountains is a great way to relax.
I like to learn about different cultures and traditions.
Volunteering in my community makes me feel fulfilled.
Finding a balance between work and personal life is essential.
Taking care of your mental health is just as important as physical health.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite travel destination and why?
Q2: What challenges do you face when planning a trip?
Q3: How do you think travel impacts personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about effective study techniques.
questions: Q1: What study methods have worked best for you?
Q2: What obstacles do you encounter while studying?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is time management for students?
Q4: What tips would you offer to improve study habits?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about fitness habits.
questions: Q1: How often do you engage in physical exercise?
Q2: What difficulties do you experience when trying to stay fit?
Q3: What is your opinion on the importance of fitness in daily life?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to someone starting a fitness journey?
